question: One view: does feeling lucky set you up for a harder fall?
answer: Believing luck will carry you can stop you from checking, so the first real blow lands from full height. Others argue that hopeful people try more and get up faster. The risk is hope that replaces the safety net.
move: The risk is not hope. It is hope that replaces the net.

web.label: A walker on a tightrope with a net below. Drag the walker along the rope to show where you stand, then rate how sure you are. Asks whether feeling lucky makes a harder fall more likely.

source: Diventare Strong, “Mentalità D'Acciaio: 7 Pensieri da Eliminare dalla Tua Mente (Atteggiamento Mentale Vincente Strong)” (YouTube, 2020)
